author: "Daniel Allington"
date: "2026-11-12"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)

options(scipen = 999)

d_gender <- read_csv('../data/BES-2017-f2f-gender-fb-tw.csv')
```

# Hypothesis
There is an association between gender and Facebook use

# Visualisation
```{r}
d_gender %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x = Gender)
  ) +
  geom_bar()
```

```{r}
d_gender %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(x = Use_Facebook)
  ) +
  geom_bar()

```

# Analysis
```{r}
test_results <- chisq.test(
  x = d_gender$Gender,
  y = d_gender$Use_Facebook
)
```

Observed counts
```{r}
test_results$observed
```

Expected counts
```{r}
test_results$expected
```


Women were found to be more likely to use Facebook, X2(N = 2189, DF = 1) = 18.046, p < .001.
